cards.title: About GeoJSON Format
cards.body: GeoJSON is a JSON-based format for geographic data, commonly used in web mapping applications and APIs.

cards.title: About KMZ Format
cards.body: KMZ is a compressed version of KML, reducing file size for easier sharing and faster loading in Google Earth.

cards.title: Why Convert GeoJSON to KMZ?
items: Smaller file size for easier sharing
Native support in Google Earth and Google Maps
Can include images and other resources
